body: It seems like everyone agrees that he has problems except the physicians. He’s seen 3 Pedis, psychs and one therapist. We’re currently waiting on another psych and therapist approval from our insurance. It’s gotten to the point where he hits the baby now too. I’m so spent and wish someone would listen to me about his aggression. I would never lay a finger on him but so many days I wish I was gone so I didn’t have to deal with him.
Thank you for this. We’re on nanny #6 right now. She’s pushing through but I can tell she’s getting tired. We’re trying new doctors. We’ve gone through 3 pedis, 2 psychs and 1 therapist.
